events.title: 윔블던, Football League members for just 10 seasons, go top of the league with a 1–0 away win over 찰턴 애슬레틱 . 올덤 애슬레틱 go top of the Second Division with a 1–0 win over 입스위치 타운 at Portman Road .
왓퍼드 sign 에버턴 midfielder Kevin Richardson for £225,000.

맨체스터 유나이티드, bottom of the table, claim their first point of the First Division campaign with a 1–1 draw at 레스터 시티. 리버풀 beat 웨스트햄 유나이티드 5–2 at Upton Park . 윔블던 stay on top with a 1–0 win at 왓퍼드. In the Second Division, 블랙번 로버스 climb into second place with a 6–1 win over 선덜랜드 at Ewood Park .
England under-21s draw 1–1 with Sweden , with 아스널 defender Tony Adams scoring their goal.

Bryan Robson makes his first league appearance since April when he returns from a shoulder injury to help 맨체스터 유나이티드 record their first league win of the season at the fifth attempt as they beat 사우샘프턴 5–1 at Old Trafford and climb off the bottom of the First Division. 노팅엄 포리스트 go top with a 6–0 home win over 애스턴 빌라.
애스턴 빌라 sack manager Graham Turner after just over two years at the helm.
Gordon Hill , the 32-year-old former 맨체스터 유나이티드 and England winger, becomes a high-profile new signing for Conference side Northwich Victoria , managed by former United striker Stuart Pearson .

리즈 유나이티드 hooligans overturn and immolate a fish and chip van at Odsal Stadium , the temporary home of 브래드퍼드 시티 . 노팅엄 포리스트 score six for the second League match in succession when they thrash 첼시 6–2 at Stamford Bridge . Nigel Clough and Garry Birtles both scores hat-trick. Newly promoted 노리치 시티 go second with a 4–1 win at 애스턴 빌라. A nine-goal thriller at Leeds Road sees 허더즈필드 타운 beat 올덤 애슬레틱 5–4 in the Second Division.

The pressure mounts on 맨체스터 유나이티드 manager Ron Atkinson after a 3–1 defeat to 에버턴 at Goodison Park , with his side still second from bottom with one win and four points from their first seven league games.
루턴 타운 are banned from this season's League Cup for refusing to lift their ban on away fans. Meanwhile, 애스턴 빌라 appoint Billy McNeill as manager from 맨체스터 시티 , who replace him with Jimmy Frizzell .
리버풀 defeat 풀럼 10–0 in the first leg of their second round tie in the League Cup.

When 노팅엄 포리스트 play Brighton & Hove Albion in a second round League Cup match, Forest defender Stuart Pearce 's brother Ray was one of the linesmen . Pearce had no idea that his brother was officiating until he saw him at the start of the match.

애스턴 빌라's first league match under Billy McNeill ends in a 3–3 draw with 리버풀 at Anfield after the hosts come from behind twice to equalise. 노팅엄 포리스트 remain top with a 1–0 win over 아스널 at the City Ground .

맨체스터 유나이티드's dismal start to the season continues as they lose 1–0 at home to 첼시 in the league at Old Trafford – their sixth defeat from their opening eight games. After Kerry Dixon gives 첼시 an early lead, the home side have two penalties saved by goalkeeper Tony Godden .

노팅엄 포리스트 are First Division leaders at the end of September, two points ahead of surprise contenders 노리치 시티 and four ahead of 리버풀 and 코번트리 시티 . 애스턴 빌라 still occupy bottom place and 맨체스터 유나이티드 are second from bottom with just four points so far this campaign. In the Second Division, 올덤 애슬레틱 and 포츠머스 lead the way, followed by 크리스털 팰리스, 리즈 유나이티드 and 셰필드 유나이티드 .
